test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rukmini Devi Arundale is the exponent of which of the following Indian classical dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale** was a reputed dancer and choreographer of Bharatnatyam
 
• In **1956**, Rukmini Devi was awarded the **Padma Bhushan**.
 
• in **1967 **she received the "**Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship**".
 
• **Rukmini Devi was the first woman** to be nominated as a member of the **Rajya Sabha**.
 
• She was featured in India Today's list of 100 people who shaped India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afea65695ef7ad4153b0f0092d253c0fb79cfa9430da168bdb3b92dc279a4f41.png]
